items.title: Joseph "Fan" Bourgeau Interview, 1972-09-13
items.q: He used to play with Bruce Armstrong.

ctx.x: What kind of band was it? I mean... Dixieland.

Yeah, and who else? I had Albert Francis playing drum. You know Albert. He used to play with Bruce Armstrong. And I had a fellow by the name of Hughes. He's playing the saxophone. What is his name? Hughes? Hughes. He was in the saxophone. Wallingford Hughes. Frenchie Hughes? I don't know what's his last name. I know his name was Hughes.
And... I have no copy of the family album. Who else? He's in the family album.
